name: Dubsado CRM
description: Dubsado is a business management platform for creative service businesses that combines client projects, lead capture, proposals, contracts, invoices, payments, scheduling, workflows, forms, client portals, tasks, time tracking, and reporting. Teams use it to qualify leads, organize project work, communicate with clients, collect signatures and payments, and automate repeatable client-service processes.
agentUseSummary: Dubsado CRM cannot yet be connected through Relay as a direct provider. Dubsado's official public integration surface documents API-key generation only for Zapier connections on Premier/admin-owner accounts, and Relay does not mount Zapier as a substitute provider API, use private browser interfaces, capture account credentials, or operate contracts, invoices, payments, forms, schedulers, workflows, portals, or projects through undocumented endpoints.

blocked.label: Connect Dubsado CRM
blocked.description: Dubsado does not publish a direct first-party REST or OAuth application contract for Relay; its public API-key guidance is specifically for Zapier.

blocked.label: Read private business data
blocked.description: Projects, clients, contacts, leads, forms, proposals, contracts, invoices, payments, schedules, workflows, portals, tasks, reports, custom fields, templates, files, email, calendar data, users, and brand settings remain unavailable to Relay.

blocked.label: Change Dubsado records
blocked.description: Creating, updating, sending, signing, countersigning, approving, invoicing, charging, scheduling, importing, exporting, archiving, deleting, or automating Dubsado business records is blocked.

blocked.label: Send client communications
blocked.description: Sending email, contract links, proposals, invoices, questionnaires, reminders, scheduler confirmations, workflow messages, or portal invitations is blocked.

blocked.label: Use Zapier as the provider API
blocked.description: Relay does not treat a Dubsado Zapier key or Zap trigger/action catalog as a direct Dubsado provider contract, lifecycle model, permission model, or audit boundary.

blocked.label: Use private Dubsado interfaces
blocked.description: Browser automation, session cookies, user passwords, traffic inspection, undocumented endpoints, guessed API origins, scraping, arbitrary requests, and unofficial APIs are not allowed.

approvalProfiles.label: Unavailable
approvalProfiles.description: No Dubsado CRM action is enabled until Dubsado or an approved commercial integration path supplies a direct, bounded provider contract covering credentials, data categories, legal records, payments, communication authority, account binding, lifecycle, rate limits, and revocation.

runtimeSupport.description: No Dubsado CRM tools are mounted without a verified direct first-party or approved commercial API contract and a bounded customer-account authority model.

providerSetup.blocker: Dubsado's public product and help materials document a hosted business-management system handling client data, contracts, invoices, payments, scheduling, workflows, forms, portals, and communications. Its public API-key instructions are scoped to Zapier, require Premier plan access, and restrict key generation to Admins and Owners under Third party connections. Dubsado does not publish a direct Relay-usable REST or OAuth application contract with endpoint schemas, scopes, account binding, pagination, rate limits, webhook semantics, token lifecycle, revocation, disconnect behavior, or third-party automation terms. Relay may not collect a Zapier key for direct use, operate through Zapier without an approved intermediary contract, inspect the signed-in app, reverse-engineer private traffic, or automate the browser.
providerSetup.nextAction: Product, partnerships, legal, privacy, security, CRM, payments, contracts, and communications owners must obtain Dubsado's current direct API documentation or explicitly approve a Zapier-mediated integration contract. Before implementation, freeze credential ownership, exact brand/account identity, plan and role requirements, readable fields, legal-record and payment exclusions, supported project/client/form/invoice/contract/scheduler/workflow operations, external communication authority, bounds, approvals, audit, retention, revocation, deletion, and disconnect behavior, then complete live acceptance in the provider-console task.

evidence.supports: Dubsado's product site identifies the service as business management software for creative service businesses and describes lead capture, contracts, invoices, payments, client onboarding, portals, scheduling, task management, reporting, and workflows.

Dubsado's official Zapier help article says the API key is generated for connecting Dubsado to Zapier, requires the Premier plan, and is available only to Admins and Owners under Third party connections; the key is shown once and must be treated like a password.
Dubsado's pricing page lists core client-management, invoicing, forms, portals, scheduling, workflow, proposal, lead-capture, and Zapier integration plan boundaries.
Dubsado publishes Terms and conditions governing service use, third-party tools, payments, AI features, account data, and prohibited uses.
Dubsado publishes a privacy policy covering collection and handling of personal, business, billing, imported contact, form, event, and website navigation data.
